summary.text: Ariel Bolles is the Democratic and Vermont Progressive Party candidate for the Vermont House of Representatives, Addison-3 District, in the November 3, 2026 general election.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a Ferrisburgh resident who does design strategy and service design for government products and websites, and said her priorities include a fairer, progressive tax system and addressing housing, healthcare and education.

paragraphs.text: Ariel Bolles earned a high school diploma from Champlain Valley Union High School and a bachelor's degree from Columbia College Chicago in 2008.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she lives in Ferrisburgh with her husband, their two children and a cat, serves on the Ferrisburgh Town Center Committee, and previously volunteered on the ANWSD Comprehensive Equity Assessment Committee.
She also said her day job is design strategy and service design for government products and websites.
Bolles advanced from the Democratic primary on August 11, 2026, finishing second behind John Stroup in a race with Michael Kane.
In the same survey, she listed equity in public education and support for local schools, human and civil rights, and expanding affordable housing among the policy areas she is passionate about.
